notablePrerequisites: You have no instants and/or sorceries in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's first ability triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
